description: Update mutable fields (summary/importance/confidence/valid_from/valid_until/metadata) in place. If content changes, a superseding memory is created by default (set supersede=false to edit in place).

content.description: New content. When provided, a superseding memory is created (supersede=true) unless supersede=false.

supersede.description: If content changes, create a superseding memory instead of editing in place (default true)

validFrom.description: ISO timestamp or null to clear

validUntil.description: ISO timestamp or null to clear

name: update_memory
title: Update a memory
